q2: SELECT DISTINCT EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL)>=2

counterexample:
INSERT INTO PERSON (ID, EMAIL) VALUES (1, 'a@example.com');
INSERT INTO PERSON (ID, EMAIL) VALUES (2, 'a@example.com');
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent. Q1 returns emails that appear more than once (COUNT(EMAIL) > 1), while Q2 returns emails that appear at least twice (COUNT(EMAIL) >= 2). These conditions are not equivalent when an email appears exactly twice, which would be included by Q2 but not by Q1.
